رَضِىَ بِمَقْصَرٍ مِنَ الأَمْرِ , and مِنْهُ ↓ بِمَقْصِرٍ , He was content with less than he was seeking, of the thing. (TA.) And مِمَّا كَانَ يُحَاوِلُ ↓ رَضِىَ بِمُقْصِرٍ with kesr to the ص, (S,) or بِمَقْصَرٍ مِنْهُ, (as in a copy of the M,) He was content with less than he was seeking. (S, M.) And رَضِيتُ مِنْ فُلَانٍ بِمَقْصَرٍ, and ↓ بِمَقْصِرٍ , I was content with an inferior thing from such a one. (M.) ＝
-A2- See also قَصْرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
